author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Why Facebook stock went up? 

I can use AI to filter out all sponsored posts in Facebook and Instagram.   I use AI to create and summarize my own feed.

If no one is reading anything without filtered and curated by your AI secretary first, no one will see any useless and unwanted ads.  Why spend money on ads for human?
